meta.title: Turkic migrations across Eurasia · 2200 BCE–1520 CE
meta.description: Supplied Turkic and associated/disputed migration cohorts across Eurasia; prehistoric reconstructions and later context retained separately. Default display unit: 1 dot = 1,000 people. The report’s original 2,500-person dot unit and dot counts remain in evidence. Low/central/high values are supplied visualization scenarios, not censuses or statistical confidence intervals.
